SODIUM-AMBER URBAN — a city's worth of sodium lamps surviving on emergency grid wash the titan from ankle to mid-torso in deep amber-orange, emergency military floodlights rake the lower legs from multiple ground angles casting overlapping hard shadows up the plating, the upper two-thirds of the titan disappear into dark sky with only reactor-core glow marking the apex, amber light pools in rubble craters below, the scene reads as an urban siege of colossal and inescapable scale

STORM-LIGHTNING FLASH — a black wall-cloud system fills the entire upper sky, a single actinic-white lightning fork freeze-silhouettes the complete titan profile against the storm mass for one violent frame, every panel edge and weapon-array outline burns white, the ground below is black except for scattered burning structures providing orange floor-level fill, the silhouette collapses back to almost nothing between strikes, the effect is a war-deity revealed and concealed by the storm itself

ARC-FLASH STROBE — a severed high-voltage transmission tower arcs actinic blue-white at the titan's foot, casting upward-raking cold light across lower plating and turning hull-panel edges into electric-blue lines, sodium-amber fills the gaps between arc-pulses from surviving urban lighting below, the upper hull reads in warm amber contrast against a dark industrial sky, crackling light-spill pools across pulverized road surface, the mood is electrically violent and catastrophically urban

NUCLEAR-WINTER OVERCAST — a perpetual ash-grey overcast diffuses all light into flat directionless fill, the titan's hull reads in dull monochrome with no specular relief, shoulder weapon-arrays provide the only contrast as blue-white combat-charges cut through the grey, distant fires glow faintly orange through the ash blanket as barely-visible smears on the horizon, the ground below is a grey rubble field with no shadow, the mood is extinction-level and utterly without mercy

REACTOR-MELTDOWN GLOW — a single distant detonation pulse erupts behind the titan, one hard point-source light radiating from just above ground level, driving hard single-direction shadows from every structural element of the titan's frame outward across the terrain, panel-shadows stretch across entire city blocks, the titan's own weapon systems pulse in secondary response, the blast-glow edge-lights the hull in white fading to orange, the mood is a planetary-scale detonation event witnessed from dangerously close

TACTICAL FLOODLIGHT ARRAY — multiple stadium-scale military floods mounted on building ruins at mid-height ring the titan's base, each at a slightly different angle, producing overlapping multi-directional shadows across lower plating that cancel and reinforce in complex grids, no single shadow dominates, the upper titan recedes into dark sky with only reactor-core and shoulder-array light remaining, the flood-lit ground zone is a bright stage of carnage surrounded by darkness, the effect is theatrical in scale and merciless in implication

ORBITAL-STRIKE BEAM — a vertical column of white-hot energy descends from above the cloud layer in the deep distance behind the titan, its point-of-impact throwing a wide atmospheric back-glow that silhouettes the entire titan profile from behind, edge-lighting all horizontal hull surfaces in white-hot rim, the titan's forward face is in relative shadow, ground-level fires compete with the distant strike-glow, the atmospheric column punches through cloud cover as pure white, the mood is a species-ending judgement-from-above

EMP-BURST CONCENTRIC — a silent-pulse blue-white electromagnetic shockwave expands concentrically across the entire sky, the wavefront passing across the titan's hull like a curtain of cold light, equipment-glow across all weapon-arrays stutters and dims then re-ignites in sequence, the shockwave's edge catches atmospheric moisture as a briefly visible blue-white halo ring, the ground below shows vehicle systems going dark as the pulse front passes, the overall mood is a technological apocalypse unfolding at atmospheric scale

ARTILLERY-WALK FIRE-FRONT — a line of artillery impacts marches across the horizon from left to right, each detonation throwing a brief orange-white flash that lights the titan's corresponding flank for a fraction of a second in sequential progression, between impacts the flank falls to ambient cold grey, the walking pattern reads across the full titan height as a shifting strobe of warm and cold, ground impact craters glow briefly then fade, the sequential rhythm creates a mechanical and inevitable wartime tempo

SMOKE-CHOKED BATTLEFIELD — dense smoke columns from a burning city district form a near-opaque ceiling at mid-titan height, the sun reduced to a dim orange disc barely visible through ash haze above, what light reaches the titan is diffuse and amber-tinted below the smoke ceiling with cold grey above, weapon-charge glow and reactor-heat create the only reliable light sources, the ground below exists in warm orange murk, the mood is a suffocating industrial-war scale catastrophe

TWILIGHT POST-ENGAGEMENT — a dying violet sky grades to deep indigo at zenith, still-burning city sectors across the ground plane throw amber fire-light upward, the titan is silhouetted black against the violet-to-fire gradient horizon, weapon-arrays have dimmed to a sullen red glow marking the machine's position against the darkening sky, smoke columns catch the last violet light as purple-grey masses, the ground is a mosaic of orange fire-pools separated by dark rubble, the mood is aftermath-of-apocalypse and vast
